title: Phaedra
summary: Raleigh names Phaedra in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Phaedra, mother in law of Hippolytus, who accused him to Theseus and afterward strangled herselfe. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. VII, sig. 271a
